faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

0.question: What services do you offer?
0.answer: We offer seven core services: Landing Pages for fast campaign launches, Website Redesigns to modernize your online presence, SEO & Performance optimization for better rankings and speed, MVP Development to validate ideas quickly, AI & Automation for intelligent workflows and custom agents, Full-Stack Applications for production-grade software that scales, and WordPress → Next.js Migration for AI-powered, done-for-you site migration with a managed edits retainer.

1.question: How fast can you deliver?
1.answer: It depends on the service. Landing pages and SEO audits ship in 1–2 weeks. Website redesigns in 2–4 weeks. MVPs and AI automation in 3–6 weeks. Full-stack applications in 4–10 weeks. You'll see real progress within the first few days regardless of scope.

2.question: What's the difference between Starter and Build?
2.answer: Starter (from €1,000) covers landing pages, website redesigns, and SEO & performance work — projects with tight scope and fast delivery. Build (from €5,000) is for MVPs, full-stack applications, and AI automation — projects that involve databases, APIs, authentication, and more complex architecture.

3.question: I just need a landing page. Is that worth it?
3.answer: Absolutely. Our Landing Pages service is designed for exactly that — a high-converting, SEO-optimized page live in under a week. Includes responsive design, analytics setup, form handling, and deployment. Starting at €1,000.

4.question: Can you help improve my existing website's performance and SEO?
4.answer: Yes, that's our SEO & Performance service. We run a full technical audit, optimize Core Web Vitals, fix page speed issues, implement schema markup, and set up monitoring. Most audits and implementations are done in 1–2 weeks.

5.question: What does your AI & Automation service include?
5.answer: Custom AI agents, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval systems (RAG), API integrations, and data pipeline automation. We use tools like Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, Anthropic, and n8n. Whether you need a chatbot, an internal assistant, or a fully automated workflow — we build it.

6.question: I have an idea but no product yet. Can you help?
6.answer: That's exactly what our MVP Development service is for. We help you scope features, design the UI, and build a working product in 3–5 weeks. You get a production-ready app with auth, payments, and analytics — ready for real users and investor demos.

7.question: When does a retainer make sense?
7.answer: When you need continuous development beyond a single project. New features, iterations, performance work, or reliable on-call support. A retainer (from €2,500/month) gives you reserved monthly capacity with priority support. Cancel anytime.

8.question: Not sure which service is right for me?
8.answer: Book a free 30-minute call. We'll assess your situation and recommend the right starting point — whether that's a quick landing page, an SEO audit, a full MVP build, or something else entirely.
